@UUID[JournalEntry.azX1hjbc0PUp2AA2.JournalEntryPage.kiaygGF4KgylB6fb]{Profile: The Archived}

The ones who were on the drive.

TypeCommando (Commando)
DomainThe Harbor Island docks, around David's hangar
Location@UUID[JournalEntry.104UV0anmZHNCTrD]{The Harbor Island Hangar}
Members@UUID[JournalEntry.zQMt8VMfKPoL6INq]{Celeste Arden}, @UUID[JournalEntry.PBJeE9T9n0BjB6ag]{Ezra “Static” Lund}, @UUID[JournalEntry.rg50DlMYSzgbZeBv]{Nadia Ferro}, @UUID[JournalEntry.B4nqUk8dojvCw97H]{Halvard “Hal” Brekke}, @UUID[JournalEntry.gRfqeOIXEHOcLemr]{Dr. Ruth Abernathy}
Allies@UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David Smith}, @UUID[JournalEntry.sP1Adp7t6FvaF4zw]{Tom “Bear” Whitman}
Handout@UUID[JournalEntry.vtenvgNlXVPd99Rc]{“Your Folder in the File”}

A coterie born of a shared threat: every one of them is in the Ward File, and either they get it back together or they go down together.

Commando: a unit assembled for one mission that became permanent (doc 02). If it survives AVE-01, it can become a Cerberus or Regency coterie, depending on the Ending (doc 08).

Domain

  • Chasse 2: Night-shift workers. Feeding is possible, but you have to be careful.
  • Lien 1: The coterie has barely any sway over the mortals at the port. Bear knows a few of them.
  • Portillon 2: Lots of access points, containers, and water. Easy to get in and out. For enemies, too.
system.privatenotes:
Domain according to doc 02: caza 2 · lien 1 · portillon 1

Backgrounds according to doc 02:

  • Haven (the hangar, on loan from David)
  • Contacts (port) 1

Alternatives:

  • B) it's a coterie that already existed, and Montgomery uses it as a strike force
  • C) they're strangers who happen to be in Helen's apartment the night of the theft
